activity.notes: Pedro I of Brazil briefly succeeded to the Portuguese crown in 1826 as Pedro IV before abdicating in favor of his daughter Maria. ATLAS records this as a separate Kingdom of Portugal sovereign Activity rather than folding it into his Brazilian imperial reign.

sources.title: D. PEDRO I do Brasil, IV de Portugal — CESEM/NOVA FCSH
sources.citation_text: The CESEM/NOVA FCSH biographical dictionary identifies Pedro I of Brazil as Pedro IV of Portugal and states that he briefly reigned in Portugal in 1826 before abdicating for his daughter.
